p: South Bridge Street is right in Airdrie town centre, the main town in this part of North Lanarkshire, and Admiral is a short walk from Airdrie station, which has trains towards Glasgow and on the line to Bathgate and Edinburgh. It's 18+ only.

Airdrieonians play at the Excelsior Stadium on the edge of town. A few miles west in Coatbridge, Summerlee Museum of Scottish Industrial Life has a working tramway, a mine and reconstructed miners' cottages, and Drumpellier Country Park has lochs and woodland walks, so there's plenty to fill a day.
